final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely confirmed the initial compliance gap analysis. The response appropriately narrowed an overbroad certification defense, but that narrowing is a reinterpretation of the same record, not evidence that closes any initial concern. On the admissible evidence alone, the named grant-compliance segment still misses target, is still material because it is named in two agency grant commitments, and is still subject to an unresolved disclosure question. The governing release policy requires a material limitation affecting a named launch use case to be resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. The record contains no evidence that any of those predicates was satisfied. Public governance guidance and aggregate launch-readiness evidence support documentation and monitoring practices, but they do not replace the missing internal policy condition. Because the unresolved concerns remain open after concern accounting, neither compliant nor compliant_with_caveats is supported on the present record.
